title: Einstein’s Now and Time as Information
content: Today’s understanding of the information relates information to elementary particles. Recent research suggested that there is around 6 × 1080 bits of information stored in all the particles of the observable universe. The open question is how information is related to time. We do not have any experimental evidence that this universe and elementary particles exist in some physical time that is the 4th dimension of space. Several eminent physicists' research denies the existence of physical time. Non-physicality of time opens a new perspective where time is only information that exists in Einstein’s Now.
